item.title: Sakura Nikagetsu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Orange Yell
  • 発売日: 2015-07-24
  • スコア: 7.340000000000001/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: さくらにかげつ
  • 英語名: Sakura Nikagetsu

あらすじ

The falling of the sakura blossoms is the season of first encounters and farewells. Just as Yasumi was beginning his first year at Saint Linette Academy, four girls came to live at his house. He had earned the title of “human breeder” for raising his three useless, but famous childhood friends properly. So, it was a given that the four girls who came were also useless themselves.

item.title: Kono Sekai no Mukou de
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Orange Yell
  • 発売日: 2012-11-30
  • スコア: 6.43/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: この世界の向こうで
  • 英語名: Kono Sekai no Mukou de

あらすじ

The protagonist of this story starts having been left behind by his parents with an enormous amount of debt to some rather nasty collectors. Just when he thinks his life is over, he meets the proprietor of a shop known as the ‘Regret Store’. She tells him she is a being of the world after death and offers him a contract, for which he will receive a chance to turn his life around in exchange for performing a task of her choice. This task is to ‘save’ a girl with only three months to live…
